mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places ( space_id, name, category, address, region, country, latitude, longitude, price_desc, price_min, price_max, currency, hours, thumbnail_url, source_url, source_platform, tags, menu, confidence, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{spaceId}, #{name}, #{category}, #{address}, #{region}, #{country}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{priceDesc}, #{priceMin}, #{priceMax}, #{currency}, #{hours}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourcePlatform}, #{tags, typeHandler=com.reeltrip.api.common.typehandler.StringListTypeHandler}, #{menu, typeHandler=com.reeltrip.api.common.typehandler.StringListTypeHandler}, #{confidence}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, space_id, name, category, address, region, country, latitude, longitude, price_desc, price_min, price_max, currency, hours, thumbnail_url, source_url, source_platform, tags, menu, confidence, created_by, consent_given, consent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM places WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, space_id, name, category, address, region, country, latitude, longitude, price_desc, price_min, price_max, currency, hours, thumbnail_url, source_url, source_platform, tags, menu, confidence, created_by, consent_given, consent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM places WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE places SET embedding = #{embedding}::vector WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.category, p.region, p.thumbnail_url, p.tags, ROUND(CAST(1 - (p.embedding <=> target.embedding) AS NUMERIC), 4) AS match_score FROM places p, (SELECT embedding FROM places WHERE id = #{placeId}) target WHERE p.id != #{placeId} AND p.embedding IS NOT NULL AND target.embedding IS NOT NULL AND p.consent_given = true ORDER BY p.embedding <=> target.embedding LIMIT #{limit}
